maintainer.contact: GitHub @LixinTu; repository PR #160 or issues tagged app:second-draft

limitations: The edit-kind rule (second-draft-edit-kind/1) is a declared test rule for checkable changes, not a judgment of good writing.
Second Draft enforces only structural limits; course AI policies and the student's assistant rules are checked by graders from the activity log.
The GUI is a read-only reviewer renderer with four views; there is no interactive business Web App.
One student account per App instance; plain text only, no rich formatting, real-time co-editing or learning-management system.
